shortDescription: grant or revoke an Automation Platform Controller role.

options.name: controller_config_file
options.description: Path to the controller config file. If provided, the other locations for config files will not be considered.

options.name: controller_host
options.description: URL to your Automation Platform Controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_HOST) and then config files If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: controller_oauthtoken
options.description: The OAuth token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_OAUTH_TOKEN) and then config files

options.name: controller_password
options.description: Password for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_PASSWORD) and then config files

options.name: controller_username
options.description: Username for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_USERNAME) and then config files

options.name: credential
options.description: Credential name, ID, or named URL the role acts on. Deprecated, use 'credentials'.

options.name: credentials
options.description: Credential names, IDs, or named URLs the role acts on.

options.name: instance_groups
options.description: Instance Group names, IDs, or named URLs the role acts on.

options.name: inventories
options.description: Inventory names, IDs, or named URLs the role acts on.

options.name: inventory
options.description: Inventory name, ID, or named URL the role acts on. Deprecated, use 'inventories'.

options.name: job_template
options.description: The job template name, ID, or named URL the role acts on. Deprecated, use 'job_templates'.

options.name: job_templates
options.description: The job template names, IDs, or named URLs the role acts on.

options.name: lookup_organization
options.description: Organization name, ID, or named URL the inventories, job templates, projects, or workflows the items exists in. Used to help lookup the object, for organization roles see organization. If not provided, will lookup by name only, which does not work with duplicates.

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization name, ID, or named URL the role acts on. Deprecated, use 'organizations'.

options.name: organizations
options.description: Organization names, IDs, or named URLs the role acts on.

options.name: project
options.description: Project name, ID, or named URL the role acts on. Deprecated, use 'projects'.

options.name: projects
options.description: Project names, IDs, or named URLs the role acts on.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the controller host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code

options.name: role
options.description: The role type to grant/revoke.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state. State of present indicates the user should have the role. State of absent indicates the user should have the role taken away, if they have it.

options.name: target_team
options.description: Team name, ID, or named URL that the role acts on. For example, make someone a member or an admin of a team. Members of a team implicitly receive the permissions that the team has. Deprecated, use 'target_teams'.

options.name: target_teams
options.description: Team names, IDs, or named URLs that the role acts on. For example, make someone a member or an admin of a team. Members of a team implicitly receive the permissions that the team has.

options.name: team
options.description: Team name, ID, or named URL that receives the permissions specified by the role. Deprecated, use 'teams'.

options.name: teams
options.description: Team names, IDs, or named URLs that receive the permissions specified by the role.

options.name: user
options.description: User name, ID, or named URL that receives the permissions specified by the role. Deprecated, use 'users'.

options.name: users
options.description: User names, IDs, or named URLs that receive the permissions specified by the role.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to AWX. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_VERIFY_SSL) and then config files

options.name: workflow
options.description: The workflow job template name, ID, or named URL the role acts on. Deprecated, use 'workflows'.

options.name: workflows
options.description: The workflow job template names, IDs, or named URLs the role acts on.
